## Section 11.1: Extra Options to `read_csv()` in `readr`

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
cars_df <- read_csv(here("data/mtcarsex.csv"))
cars_df
## there are issues with this! fixed below
```

```{r}
## skip = 2 skips reading in the first two lines 
read_csv(here("data/mtcarsex.csv"), skip = 2,
         na = c("", "NA", "-999"),
         col_types = cols(
           mpg = col_double(),
           cyl = col_factor(),   ## can change this to col_factor()
           disp = col_double(),
           hp = col_double(),
           drat = col_double(),
           wt = col_double(),
           qsec = col_double(),
           vs = col_factor(),
           am = col_factor(),
           gear = col_double(),
           carb = col_double()
         )) |>
  slice(-(1:2))
## na controls what values get read in as missing
## col_types controls the variable classes that R tries to read
## columns in as (can get cols with read_csv(...) |> spec() )
```

```{r}

           weekday = col_factor(),

           stepgoal = col_logical()
         ))
```

## Section 11.2: Web/Data Scraping

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)

## provide the URL and name it something (in this case, url).
url <- "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gun_violence_in_the_United_States_by_state"

## read_html() convert the html code from the URL into something R can read
tab <- read_html(url) |> 
  html_nodes("table") ## html_nodes can grab only the tables 

tab[[1]] |> html_table() ## convert tab[[1]] to a tibble
tab[[2]] |> html_table()
tab[[3]] |> html_table()
```

## Class Exercises

Class Exercise 1.


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
read_delim(here("data/birthdays.txt"), delim = " - ",
           skip = 4,
           col_names = c("birthday", "name", "species", "time"),
           na = c("", "NA", "?", "N/A"),
           col_types = cols(
             birthday = col_character(), ## need lubridate to deal with dates
             name = col_character(),
             species = col_factor(),
             time = col_character()  ## need parse_number()
           )) |>
  mutate(time = parse_number(time))

```

Class Exercise 4.

```{r}
library(rvest)

tab_allen_stats <- read_html(url1) |> html_nodes("table")
allen_df <- tab_allen_stats[[6]] |> html_table()
allen_df

## these don't work because there are duplicated column names

## allen_df |> filter(Fumbles == "0")
```

Class Exercise 5.

```{r}
tennis_url <- "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Current_tennis_rankings"
tennis_tables <- read_html(tennis_url) |> html_nodes("table")

rankings_table <- tennis_tables[[2]] |> html_table()
rankings_df <- rankings_table |> row_to_names(1) |> clean_names()

rankings_clean <- rankings_df |> mutate(points = parse_number(points)) |>
  mutate(player = fct_reorder(player, points))
ggplot(data = rankings_clean, aes(x = points, y = player)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = player), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  theme_minimal()
```
